resources.string: Sign in to view this video?

X requires login to view this post. Sign in on the official X page to let Natsuko retrieve its videos. Your password is entered directly on X. Natsuko encrypts the login session on this device and keeps it across app restarts until you disconnect or X reports it expired. Signing in does not remove age or account restrictions.
Your X login is saved on this device and will be reused after restarting the app.
You can also sign in before retrying a post whose availability could not be determined. Signing in does not guarantee access.
